time_range.description: Effective start/end are Unix seconds, step is seconds, and filters contain literal label values.

dashboard_version.description: Upstream dashboard revision number (identifier, no physical unit).

dashboard_url.description: Grafana browser URL; its from/to query parameters are Unix milliseconds, while action start/end inputs are Unix seconds.

queried_at.description: Gateway query time as a timezone-qualified RFC3339 timestamp.

query.description: PromQL query text; runtime limit is 32768 UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII queries may contain fewer characters.

parameters.description: Effective query parameters: time/start/end are Unix seconds and step is seconds.

result.description: Native Prometheus result. Sample timestamps are Unix seconds; numeric sample values retain the queried expression's unit, including numeric strings. Determine value units from the metric/expression and dashboard field configuration; no implicit conversion.
